column4: We currently bill a flat monthly price per seat. Customers running large API workloads pay the same as light users, and finance cannot price heavy usage. This PRD introduces metered billing for API calls on top of the seat price.

column3: Meter every billable API call per customer account with an idempotency key
column4:
As a billing admin, I want the system to meter every billable API call per customer account with an idempotency key, so that it supports the goal "Charge customers in proportion to API usage".

h4. Acceptance criteria
* *Given* a billing admin, *when* the same idempotency key is received twice, *then* usage is counted once

h4. Traceability
* FR-1 (examples/usage-based-billing.md:33): The system must meter every billable API call per customer account with an idempotency key.

Estimate rationale: base 1; +2 distributed-state complexity (idempotency) = score 3 -> 3 pts

column3: Aggregate metered usage into hourly totals per account and price dimension
column4:

h4. Acceptance criteria
* *Given* a billing admin, *when* an hour closes, *then* its totals are final within 15 minutes

h4. Traceability
* FR-2 (examples/usage-based-billing.md:34): The system must aggregate metered usage into hourly totals per account and price dimension.

Estimate rationale: base 1; +2 distributed-state complexity (aggregate); +1 measurable performance target (within 15 minutes) = score 4 -> 5 pts
